build.beforeDevCommand: npm run build && cargo build -p easypdf-worker
build.beforeBuildCommand: npm run build && cargo build --release -p easypdf-worker && bash ../../scripts/prepare-bundle.sh release

security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.longDescription: View, edit, annotate, sign, and encrypt PDFs. No account, no cloud, no subscription.
